expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Two countries, two hotels, one flight. Saigon and Angkor are an hour apart by air and nothing like each other.
expert.tip: Do Angkor Wat at sunrise if your guide will take you. The towers against the first light are worth losing the lie in.

summary: Eight days across two countries: four nights in Saigon with a city tour, the Cu Chi tunnels and a free day, then three in Siem Reap with the floating villages of Tonle Sap and a full day among the Angkor temples.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast and dinner in Siem Reap; the flight between the two countries; private transfers throughout; a Saigon city tour; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour; a Tonle Sap lake boat ride; an Angkor Wat day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam and Cambodia visa fees; lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
